summary: In a deserted alley, Cypher steps onto a dumpster in front of a small boarded-up window. He positions himself to reach the window, which serves as the exit at the old TV repair shop on Franklin and Erie.

what_changes.before: Standing on the ground in the deserted alley.
what_changes.after: Elevated on a dumpster, in front of the small boarded-up window, ready to exit.
what_changes.evidence: In a deserted alley, Cypher steps onto a dumpster in front of a small boarded-up window.

event_hint.one_line: Cypher reaches the TV repair shop exit and climbs toward it to leave the Matrix.
